contentText:
Stella Lefty reaches a new high on this week’s top 10 on the Hot 100 chart with her hit “Boston,” and Ella Langley continues to reach new record highs with “Choosin’ Texas.”

Tetris Kelly: This is the Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 for the week dated Aug. 29. “Be Her” is still locked at 10, as is “Man I Need” at nine, “Dracula” at No. 8, “So Easy” at No. 7, Ella and Morgan at No. 6, and Ariana Grande at No. 5. “Been By Now” is down to four, Taylor Swift slips to three, while “Boston” hits a new high. So tying Lil Nas X and Shaboozey with 19 weeks at No. 1 is Ella Langley.
